notes: Share-page text whose speaker lines end in an ellipsis like a preview, while the text after them does not repeat it.

Apple discards the text after the header as a preview. Here the next line does not begin with it, so the words exist nowhere else and are lost. The web app drops such text only when the first non-blank line after it begins with it, after one trailing ellipsis has been cut for the comparison; otherwise it keeps the text as the first line of the turn, ellipsis included.
